values: 自身的最大生命值降低，可额外布置2个激光塔协助作战。主动使用时为自身和激光塔提高攻击速度和攻击力，并提高激光塔的伤害。
Zanie reduces her max HP and deploys 2 laser turrets. When actively used, Zanie increases ATK and ATK SPD for herself and her laser turrets, while boosting laser turrets' damage dealt.

被动地，自身最大生命值降低15%，战斗开始时可以额外布置2座固定在战场上的激光塔，继承自身140%的最大生命值和80%的攻击力并处于霸体状态。激光塔会发射一道激光随机攻击5格范围内的敌人，造成激光塔攻击力100%的伤害。若战斗开始时2座激光塔距离不超过2格，则视作“串联”状态，激光塔将汇聚能量持续发射激光，攻击最近的一名敌人，每0.5秒造成激光塔攻击力总和55%的伤害，并额外摧毁目标至多相当于激光塔攻击力总和30%的护盾。
主动使用时，使自身和激光塔攻击速度提升15 + 4，攻击力提升20% + 2%，持续10秒。期间激光塔的攻击会额外附带目标3%当前生命值的伤害，这部分伤害不超过激光塔攻击力的60%。

Passive. Zanie has her max HP reduced by 15%. When a battle starts, she deploys 2 laser turrets, that inherit 140% of her max HP and 80% of her ATK. These turrets are immobile and unaffected. Each turret fires lasers at random enemies within 5 tiles, dealing damage equal to 100% of the laser turret's ATK. If the 2 turrets start the battle within 2 tiles of each other, they become linked, combining their energy to fire at the nearest enemy, dealing damage equal to 55% of the laser turrets' total ATK every 0.5s. This combined attack also reduces the target's shield value by up to 30% of the laser turrets' total ATK.

Active. Zanie increases ATK SPD by 15 + 4 and ATK by 20% + 2% for herself and her laser turrets for 10s. During this time, laser turret attacks deal extra damage equal to 3% of the target's current HP, up to 60% of the laser turret's ATK.
主动使用时，获得的攻击速度提升至20 + 4。
When actively used, increases ATK SPD by 20 + 4.
主动使用时，获得的攻击速度提升至25 + 4。
When actively used, increases ATK SPD by 25 + 4.
主动使用时，获得的攻击速度提升至30 + 4。
When actively used, increases ATK SPD by 30 + 4.
主动使用时，获得的攻击速度提升至35 + 4。
When actively used, increases ATK SPD by 35 + 4.
战斗开始时建造一个机枪塔，优先攻击最靠近激光塔的敌人。
When a battle starts, Zanie builds a gun turret that prioritizes attacking the enemy closest to any laser turret.
被动地，战斗开始时在自身面前一格建造一个机枪塔，继承自身70%的最大生命值和攻击力。机枪塔拥有3格攻击距离，且优先攻击范围内最靠近激光塔的敌人，每次普通攻击造成机枪塔攻击力100% + 10%的伤害。机枪塔每进行2次普通攻击后，下次普通攻击改为对敌人进行猛烈打击，造成6次机枪塔攻击力50%的伤害，每发子弹造成0.5秒的眩晕和击退效果。

Passive. When a battle starts, Zanie builds a gun turret in front of her. The turret inherits 70% of her max HP and ATK. Its normal attack has a range of 3 tiles and deals damage equal to 100% + 10% of the gun turret's ATK, prioritizing the enemy closest to any laser turret. After 2 normal attacks, the gun turret charges up its next attack into a devastating heavy barrage that fires 6 consecutive rounds at the enemy. Each round deals damage equal to 50% of the gun turret's ATK, stuns the enemy for 0.5s, and knocks them back.
机枪塔继承自身最大生命值和攻击力的比例提升至75%。
The gun turret now inherits 75% of Zanie's max HP and ATK.
机枪塔继承自身最大生命值和攻击力的比例提升至80%。
The gun turret now inherits 80% of Zanie's max HP and ATK.
机枪塔继承自身最大生命值和攻击力的比例提升至85%。
The gun turret now inherits 85% of Zanie's max HP and ATK.
战斗中可维修自己建造的塔，使其回复生命值并获得护盾。
Zanie can repair one of her turrets during battle, restoring its HP and granting it a shield.
被动地，每场战斗一次，自己的机枪塔被摧毁时，会移动到残骸处将其完全修复，并添加可抵御500% ATK伤害的护盾，随后返回原来的位置。主动释放时，移动至最虚弱的激光塔附近对其进行维修，使激光塔总共回复300% + 45% ATK的生命值，并获得可抵御500% + 50% ATK伤害的护盾，随后返回原来的位置。

Passive. When her gun turret is destroyed, Zanie moves to its remains to fully repair it and grant it a shield that can block 500% ATK damage. She then returns to her original position. This effect can only be triggered once per battle.
Active. Zanie moves to the weakest laser turret to repair it, restoring 300% + 45% ATK HP and granting it a shield that blocks 500% + 50% ATK damage. Zanie then returns to her original position.
主动释放时，为激光塔回复的生命值提升至350% + 45% ATK。
When actively used, increases HP restored to a turret to 350% + 45% ATK.
主动释放时，为激光塔回复的生命值提升至400% + 45% ATK。
When actively used, increases HP restored to a turret to 400% + 45% ATK.
主动释放时，为激光塔回复的生命值提升至450% + 45% ATK。
When actively used, increases HP restored to a turret to 450% + 45% ATK.
Increases the hero's Penetration during battle.
战斗中，自身的穿透提升12点。
战斗中，自身的穿透提升16点。
战斗中，自身的穿透提升20点。
使一座塔升级为更强力的形态。
Upgrades a turret to make it more powerful.
每隔22秒，将一座塔升级为更强力的形态，使其提升40%的最大生命值和攻击力，并且射程增加1格。本技能会优先选择最靠前的激光塔，每场战斗中一座塔至多升级1次。

Every 22s, Zanie upgrades one of her turrets, increasing its max HP and ATK by 40% and expanding its range by 1 tiles. She will prioritize upgrading the frontmost laser turret. Each turret can only be upgraded once per battle.
最大生命值和攻击力提升比例增加到50%。
Max HP and ATK boosts for upgraded turrets are increased to 50%.
本技能的释放间隔降低至15秒。
最大生命值和攻击力提升比例增加到60%。
Max HP and ATK boosts for upgraded turrets are increased to 60%.
激光塔的攻击会给敌人施加灼烧效果。
Laser turret attacks burn enemies hit.
激光塔的攻击命中敌人时会使其灼烧，攻击力降低20%且每秒受到激光塔攻击力100%的伤害，持续5秒，灼烧效果不可叠加。当激光塔处于“串联”状态时，灼烧效果额外使敌人降低30%的护甲。

When a laser turret hits an enemy, it burns them, reducing their ATK by 20% and dealing damage equal to 100% of the turret's ATK per second for 5s. The burn effect cannot stack. If the turret is linked to the other laser turret, the burn effect also reduces the enemy's Phys DEF by 30%.
